name: Ashley Moody
desc: United States Senator from Florida since 2025
summary:
Ashley Brooke Moody (born March 28, 1975) is an American politician and attorney serving since 2025 as the junior United States Senator from Florida. A member of the Republican Party, she served from 2019 to 2025 as the 38th Florida Attorney General.
Born in Plant City, Florida, Moody is an alumna of the University of Florida and Stetson University.
